about: Numbers for the calculator (fogscout/gencalc.py): generator repair (mechanics, toolboxes, survivor, killer) and every other action or movement speed (areas, medkits, perks). Facts only, taken from the Dead by Daylight Wiki (deadbydaylight.wiki.gg, text licence CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 – no text was copied) – see THIRD_PARTY.md. Check after every game patch.
source_state: Module:Datatable/Loadout as of 2026-11-05, Generators 2026-08-31, Dead by Daylight Maths 2026-04-12, Toolboxes 2025-06-16, Skill Checks 2026-06-17; areas: Health States, Med-Kits, Movement Speeds, Vaulting, Pallets, Totems, Chests, Exit Gates, Hooks, Breakable Walls, Lockers and Patch Notes 9.6.X as read on 2026-11-15, Module:Datatable/Loadout/Descriptions as of 2026-11-06; Module:Datatable (killers), Status HUD/Mangled, Toolboxes and item/add-on descriptions as read on 2026-11-15; Calm Spirit, Dark Arrogance, Slippery Meat (patch 10.3.0) and the Skill Check perks (Deadline, Technician, One-Two-Three-Four!, Bardic Inspiration, Unnerving Presence) from Module:Datatable/Loadout and /Descriptions as fetched on 2026-11-15

survivor.name: Prove Thyself
survivor.when: per other Survivor at the Generator (within 4 m), for everyone there; one instance

survivor.name: Déjà Vu
survivor.when: on the 3 Generators closest to one another

survivor.name: Overzealous (Dull Totem)
survivor.when: after cleansing or blessing a Dull Totem, until a Health State is lost

survivor.name: Overzealous (Hex Totem)
survivor.when: after cleansing or blessing a Hex Totem, until a Health State is lost

survivor.name: Teamwork: Full Circuit
survivor.when: repairing with at least one other Survivor

survivor.name: Teamwork: Soft-Spoken
survivor.when: repairing with at least one other Survivor

survivor.name: Friendly Competition
survivor.when: for 90 s after completing a Generator with another Survivor, for everyone who took part

survivor.name: Boon: Steadfast
survivor.when: Generators inside the Boon's range; they also regress 50 % slower; one instance

survivor.name: Hyperfocus
survivor.when: each Great Skill Check in a row adds a Token (max 6): +30 % of the bonus and +4 percentage points Skill Check trigger odds per Token (the faster pointer is not modelled)

survivor.name: Invocation: Weaving Spiders
survivor.when: after the Invocation: every Generator needs 10 Charges less; one instance

survivor.name: Specialist
survivor.when: 6 Tokens used on one Generator (4 Charges per Token)

survivor.name: Fast Track
survivor.when: 3 Tokens used on one Generator (5 Charges per Token)

survivor.name: Deadline
survivor.when: injured (the calculator counts it as met): Skill Check odds +6/8/10 % (tier III), added to the chance per second (8 % → 18 %); the penalty of a missed check (−10 % progress) halved, the 3 s pause stays; healing is not calculated (the heal rows have no Skill Checks)

survivor.name: Technician
survivor.when: a missed Skill Check costs 4/3/2 % (tier III: 2 %) more progress – added to the 10 %; with Deadline the sum is halved (order not stated in the wiki: assumption)

survivor.name: One-Two-Three-Four!
survivor.when: for 90 s after the Performance (counted as active): Survivors within 16 m – the performer too, the wiki says 'Survivors', not 'other Survivors' – get Skill Check odds +20 %, added to the chance per second (8 % → 28 %); one instance; the Performance itself is not counted; healing not calculated

survivor.name: Bardic Inspiration
survivor.when: for 90 s after the Performance (counted as active), only OTHER Survivors within 16 m: every successful Skill Check grants extra progress by a d20 roll – 1: nothing (scream), 2–10: +1 %, 11–19: +2 %, 20: +3 % – expected value 0.45 · 1 + 0.45 · 2 + 0.05 · 3 = 1.5 % (assumption: one roll per Performance, every face equally likely, so the mean over many Performances); one instance; the Performance itself is not counted; healing not calculated

killer.name: Dying Light / Cull the Weak
killer.count_means: Tokens (hooks of Survivors other than the Obsession); the Obsession itself is not slowed

killer.name: Distressing
killer.count_means: Survivors inside the Terror Radius (1 = yes)

killer.name: Scourge Hook: Weeping Wounds
killer.count_means: Survivors under its effect after being healed to full (1 = yes)

killer.name: Pop Goes the Weasel
killer.count_means: kicks with the perk active (20 % instead of 5 %)

killer.name: Surge
killer.count_means: downs with a Basic Attack within 32 m of this Generator

killer.name: Eruption
killer.count_means: downs while this Generator is marked by a kick

killer.name: Undone
killer.count_means: Tokens used with the first kick

killer.name: Deadlock / No Holds Barred
killer.count_means: times this Generator is the one blocked

killer.name: Grim Embrace
killer.count_means: first hooks (1–3; the fourth blocks for 40 s)

killer.name: Corrupt Intervention
killer.count_means: 1 = this Generator is one of the three blocked at the start

killer.name: Unnerving Presence
killer.when: Survivors repairing inside the Terror Radius (counted as met): Skill Check odds +10 %, added to the chance per second (8 % → 18 %); the smaller success zone (−40/50/60 %) only changes the share of Great and missed checks, which is set on the page – not calculated

killer.name: Hex: Huntress Lullaby
killer.when: while the Hex Totem stands (counted as met): a missed Repair Skill Check costs 2/4/6 % (tier III: 6 %) more progress – added to the 10 % like Technician (10 % → 16 %; with Deadline the sum is halved: assumption); the shorter or missing warning (Tokens per hook) only changes the share of missed checks, which is set on the page – not calculated; healing is not calculated (the heal rows have no Skill Checks).

not_relevant.Fogwise: Great Skill Checks only reveal the Killer's aura
not_relevant.Gearhead: Good Skill Checks only reveal the Survivor's aura to the Killer
not_relevant.Human Greed: kicking chests shut and auras; no speed
not_relevant.Last Standing: unused in the game (early version of Left Behind)
not_relevant.This Is Not Happening: a larger Good zone only changes the share of missed checks, which is set on the page
not_relevant.Will to Live: a Skill Check to escape the Killer's grasp; no speed
